subject: Telemetry integration readiness & MAP for Labspark
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara@labspark.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry integration readiness & MAP for Labspark

Hi Cara —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our run-through, I pulled together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a checklist focused on telemetry handoff items so the Ops team can consume traces and alerts reliably. High-level asks from Redwood:

- Access to a short sample of spans/trace IDs for the two most common failure flows (auth timeout, token refresh).
- Confirmation on their alerting cadence and pager windows (who owns P0/P1).
- A small S3 bucket or shared Drive with the SOC2 log extract we requested earlier for our security review.

I've attached a starter MAP and telemetry checklist. Proposed next steps:
1) Labspark provides the trace sample and SOC2 extract by EOD next Tuesday (2026-09-14).
2) Redwood shares a draft runbook and alert-routing proposal by Friday (2026-09-17).
3) 30-minute follow-up to validate runbook and confirm on-call owners (suggested 2026-09-18).

Can you confirm the timeline and whether Samir should be our security contact for the SOC2 artifact?

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Principal CS Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri@redwood.ai
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.md, redwood-telemetry-checklist.xlsx

From: Cara Nguyen <cara@labspark.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@labspark.com>, ops-team@labspark.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry integration readiness & MAP for Labspark

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the clear asks and the MAP. We can deliver the trace samples and SOC2 extract by the 14th as requested. Samir will lead the security handoff (copied). A few clarifications from our side:

- Trace sample: we have traces in Zipkin format. Is that OK or do you need OTLP/Jaeger?
- Pager ownership: our SRE handles P0 overnight; dev teams own P1 daytime. I’ll attach the on-call rotation.
- For the SOC2 file: we’ll drop a redacted extract to the Drive link you shared and also share an S3 presigned link in case the Drive has upload size limits.

We noticed a short item in your checklist about "prefetching KV caches for hot prompts" — that looks Redwood-specific. Can you call that out in the runbook draft so our infra team can review?

I’ll upload the artifacts later today. Thanks — looking forward to the follow-up.

—Cara Nguyen
Head of Platform Ops | Labspark
cara@labspark.com
Attachments: labspark-oncall-rotation.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry integration readiness & MAP for Labspark

Priyom —

Thanks for getting the MAP out. Couple of internal notes after reviewing Cara’s reply and the artifacts they uploaded:

- Format: Labspark uploaded Zipkin traces. Our runtime accepts Zipkin but we should include a short conversion snippet to OTLP for parity with our dashboards. I can add that to the runbook.
- Alerts: their on-call split is fine, but we should propose an alert-routing policy that sends P0 to Labspark SRE + Redwood on-call and P1 to the dev owner only. That prevents noisy pages to our on-call for user-level issues.
- Prefetch/KV note: yes, this is model-serving config; we should add a section that describes when to enable prefix cache priming (only for endpoints with >100 qps sustained).
- Runbook skeleton: I sketched an incident triage flow (Who -> First actions -> Escalation -> Postmortem link) and attached an editable copy.

Proposed internal owners:
- Runbook author: Marissa Cole
- Tracing conversion + dashboard mapping: Laura Bennett
- Alert-routing + SLO checks: Ben Carter

I’ll assemble a single-runbook bundle and share by EOD Thursday (2026-09-17). Priyom — can you confirm you’ll own the follow-up meeting invite and include their security contact?

Marissa
Senior Customer Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachments: runbook-skeleton.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara@labspark.com>, Samir Rao <samir@labspark.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, ops-team@labspark.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry integration readiness & MAP for Labspark

Thanks, all — quick status update and action items: 

- Labspark delivered the trace sample (Zipkin) and SOC2 extract via Drive and S3 (links above). Confirmed.
- Redwood to deliver: combined runbook bundle (runbook + conversion snippet + alert-routing) by EOD today (2026-09-17) — attaching redwood-telemetry-checklist.xlsx.
- Meeting: scheduled 2026-09-18 10:00 PT — invite sent to SRE and security.

Immediate asks for Labspark before the meeting:
1) Confirm that the Zipkin samples include the auth and token-refresh traces (file names: auth-failure-1.json, token-refresh-2.json).
2) Confirm Samir will accept a brief security Q&A during the call.

If both are confirmed we’ll walk the conversion snippet live and lock the alert-routing rules.

Thanks — see attached and see you on the call.

Priyom Das
Principal CS Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193
Attachments: redwood-telemetry-checklist.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.md
